"""Reduce actual pre-clip traces without new training or forward calls."""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v2')
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');cache=read(plan['cache']['path']);training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json')
groups=[]
for arm in training['counts']:
    for adc in [True,False]:
        rows=[r['arms'][arm] for r,b in zip(training['trace'],cache['batches'],strict=True)
            if (b['metadata']['noise']['shot']==b['metadata']['noise']['read']==0)==adc]
        norms=np.array([r['gradient_norm'] for r in rows],dtype=np.float64)
        groups.append({'arm':arm,'ADC_only':adc,'batches':len(rows),
            'norm_median':float(np.median(norms)),'norm_maximum':float(norms.max()),
            'norms_over_one':int((norms>1).sum()),'sum_norm_capped_at_one_squared_proxy':float((np.minimum(norms,1)**2).sum()),
            'exact_zero_norms':int((norms==0).sum()),'exact_zero_total_losses':sum(r['loss']==0 for r in rows)})
output=root/'training-routing-summary-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-recorded-trace-reduction','training':ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),
    'cache':plan['cache'],'groups':groups,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'scope':'Two identical V167 bounded-support heads,124909 parameters/47 tensors,support floor.25,all90 neural source files unchanged. Only candidate data distribution differs:171/341 mesh batches replace periods6..32 with6..10 and balanced contrast bands.02,.05,.125,.25,.4;829 original batches/parents unchanged. Camera/CFA/geometry/background/exposure/noise coefficients/seeds match;changed Poisson rates do not imply identical noisy draws. New clean empty targets exactly match legacy. Same V167 common fixed-support surrogate routing/weight1/unit16,difference1/floor2/epsilon.003,anchor.25,base losses/init/AdamW/LR/clipping/EMA. 1000updates each,fixed raw/EMA endpoints/all822 cases,3288 review roots/1644 new external arrays and1644 actual bit-exact V167 control replays. No architecture,loss or held-out input changes;frequency and contrast change jointly,not isolated factors. New data cache has171 original parent/DINO roots plus171 explicit archived-deterministic-policy validation roots;684images each pass,342root/1368images total per parent/backbone. All inputs/noise constructed once;6 inspected inputs adopted and165additional inputs. Head stages have20 discarded smoke+2000 train+3288 review=5308roots/11368images,with no new compatibility roots becauseall90 neural sources match. 288 CPU checks;genuine8+2 restoration;94 final Adam states;all1000 V167 control trace/raw/EMA/Adam and1644 actual outputs must reproduce. Actual units and masks need audits for171 new target batches;829 inherited masks replay separately. Both GFX scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs and18held-out IDs stay excluded;references qualitative,notGT.72native figures/24triplets/actual viewing/eight retained comparators.
